sophie_cs: Customer (AcmePayments) opened a ticket — after this morning's model swap to rwdl-model-v4.0 their invoice-generation function started returning schema validation errors. They see a 400 with 'missing field: currency'.

alex_support: Can you paste the exact error payload they see? any repro code?

sophie_cs: Here is the server side log they pasted: 
```
ERROR: function-invoke: invoice_gen -> schema_validation_failed
model: rwdl-model-v4.0
request_id: req_8b3f
missing: [currency]
args: {"amount": 1200, "customer_id": "acme-42"}
```

maria_engineer: interesting — on v3.9 we had a compatibility shim that auto-inferred currency from account settings. v4.0 tightened the schema for tool args and removed coercions. Looks like the model is now choosing a different tool signature variant.

alex_support: Customer confirmed same request works if they pin model to rwdl-model-v3.9. So it's model-version-specific.

maria_engineer: Can we reproduce quickly? i'll try feeding the same prompt + function spec to the canary endpoint. If model chooses invoice_api_v2 which requires currency, vs invoice_api_legacy that inferred it, that would explain.

tj_prod: Noted — we got a handful of negative canary flags for function-choice drift during the rollout, but nothing auto-rolled back. Suggest blocking the rest of the rollout until we assess severity. :warning:

deploy_bot: deploy_event: roll-forward rwdl-model-v4.0 to prod completed 2026-03-17T09:12:01Z. Canary sample size: 2500 requests, function-invocation-diff: 0.8% flagged.

maria_engineer: Repro steps i used: 
1) call assistant with system prompt + user schema described 
2) send following call: 
```json
{"prompt":"Generate invoice","functions":[{"name":"invoice_gen","parameters":{"type":"object","properties":{"amount":{"type":"number"},"currency":{"type":"string"},"customer_id":{"type":"string"}},"required":["amount","customer_id"]}}],"function_call":{"name":"invoice_gen"}}
```
With v3.9 the model returns: function call with args {"amount":1200,"customer_id":"acme-42","currency":"USD"}. With v4.0 it returns {"amount":1200,"customer_id":"acme-42"} (no currency).

alex_support: Customer impact: invoice pipeline fails downstream, SDK surfaces 400 to users, billing entries blocked. High priority.

maria_engineer: Root cause hypothesis: v4.0 introduces a new reasoning heuristic that prunes inferred slots unless the function spec marks them as required. We need either to update function spec required[] to include currency, or reintroduce the shim in the runtime that fills currency from account metadata. Quick patch options: 
- hotfix runtime shim on Dedicated/Private to supply currency when missing (fast)
- revert v4.0 rollout to v3.9 (slow but safe)
- patch model routing to prefer legacy tool variant for invoice prompts (config change)

tj_prod: Ops preference: revert global rollout for now while we push a targeted fix. can we do a partial rollback to only affected regions/customers?

maria_engineer: We can abort the roll-forward and cut back to v3.9 for prod within 20 minutes. I'll open a rollback PR and coordinate with infra.

alex_support: I'll notify the customer and ask for any urgent workarounds (have them pin model param or include currency explicitly).

sophie_cs: Customer reply: they can add currency for now but want timeframe for full fix. Please keep me posted.

deploy_bot: action_required: rollback request created by maria_engineer. CI checks okay. ETA: 18 minutes.

maria_engineer: After rollback i'll also add an automated test in the canary suite to detect tool-signature drift for function calls for next rollouts. Also will add a note in the rollout playbook to look at function-choice diffs >0.2%.

tj_prod: Good. Also add an alert to Console that surfaces 'function schema regressions' tied to recent model rollouts so support sees it earlier.

alex_support: Thanks team — i'll update the ticket and escalate to enterprise CS for Acme.

sophie_cs: ACK, pls cc me on rollback completion and customer message. :pray:
